summary: Full backend + frontend E2E for Gare Ufficiali Live. Backend: 24/24 pytest pass (3 tests in the old test_fipsas_api.py were out of date with the new table scoring and have been updated; added a new test_fipsas_surf_points.py). Frontend: every requested flow passes. Home lists gare with the In Corso Live one first, plus a live banner. Classifica settori are lists (no tables) and SETTORE C TECNICO has a yellow header (rgb 253,224,71). Settori/Società/Assoluta tabs and the Campo gara list work. Admin: Utenti grouped by Giudici/Ispettori/Admin, pending box + Approva work, then login succeeds. Specie: 52 rows, 77 inputs, Salva sends PUT with 77 ints and gets 200. PDF upload shows up on the home Circolari list and the file serves as application/pdf. Register as Giudice then try to log in gives 'Account in attesa di approvazione dell'Admin'. Giudice: demo banner reads '24 ISCRITTI => A10 B10 C TECNICO 4 - NESSUN POSTO VUOTO'; created a new gara, ran Preset demo 24 + Sorteggia, Campo gara list shows 24 picchetti. Invite nuovoisp to SETTORE B -> ispettore (390px) sees the invite card, accepts, sees picchetti 11-20. Preview for Spigola 30 cm = 416 punti (= table[23]); 9 cm shows 'Sotto misura (min 12 cm) · 0 punti'. Validazione badge count is right; approve works; reject with an empty motivo is blocked, with a motivo it works; ispettore storico shows APPROVATA / RIGETTATA + motivo. Chat works both ways. Chiudi gara on the new gara -> CONCLUSA; ispettore sees 'Gara conclusa.' and the send button is hidden; the API returns 400 'Gara conclusa'.

minor.issue: CONFIRMED BUG: deleting a gara does not delete or revoke its inviti. An IN_ATTESA invite for the deleted gara still shows in the ispettore panel. If the ispettore accepts it, user.gara_id points to a gara that no longer exists and GET /api/ispettore/live returns 404 'Gara non trovata' from then on, so the ispettore panel is broken until the invite is revoked or the DB is fixed. Repro: create gara -> invite ispettore -> delete gara -> ispettore accepts -> /ispettore/live 404.

No brute-force lockout: after 6 wrong passwords a correct login still returns 200. Auth uses a Bearer token in localStorage, not httpOnly cookies. CORS reflects any Origin (https://evil.com is allowed) with allow_credentials=True because CORS_ORIGINS='*'.

With 24 iscritti in 6 boxes of 4 and settori A10 B10 C4, only 5 whole boxes fit, so 1 box is always split across sectors. This comes from the numbers, not the code, but there is no warning to the giudice.
Does not check that the user exists; returns ok for an unknown uid. PUT /api/users does not validate the role value.
A giudice can set a Conclusa gara back to In Corso Live, which reopens editing after the closure. Confirm this is intended.

issues: The content container is wider than the TopBar container: content x is about 274-1293 px vs TopBar 327-1241 px at 1920 width, so the edges do not line up.
Rows show the measure but not the computed punti; showing the points (or 'sotto misura') would help the giudice.
Gara cards fade in slowly, so the lower cards are very faded in the first second.

action_items: In delete_gara also delete (or mark REVOCATO) the gara's inviti. In rispondi_invito check that the gara still exists before accepting. In isp_live, if user.gara_id points to a missing gara, reset it instead of returning 404.
Optional hardening: login rate limit / lockout; set explicit CORS_ORIGINS.
Optional: warn the giudice when a Box/Coppie draw has to split a group.
